anyOf.description: A receipt must carry at least one verifiable piece of evidence: a seller reference number, or a screenshot hash.

description: A shareable, public cancellation receipt. Version 0.1. See CANCEL-PROOF-SPEC-v0.1.md. Receipts are public by design: they MUST NOT contain passwords, full account numbers, or payment details.

type.description: How the account is identified. Partial or hashed only — never a full identifier.

datetime_utc.description: When the cancellation happened, UTC, ISO 8601, Zulu form.

reference.description: Confirmation/reference number given by the seller, if any.

charges_after_cancel.description: Charges the seller placed after the cancellation. Used as chargeback/dispute evidence.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD, EUR.

created_utc.description: When this receipt file was created, UTC, ISO 8601, Zulu form.

items.description: Controlled vocabulary. Feeds the dark-pattern incident registry (phase 2).

screenshot_filename.description: Original filename of the screenshot, for the holder to find it again.

screenshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the screenshot file. The screenshot itself is NOT stored in the receipt.

issuer.description: Who issued the receipt. v0.1 receipts are consumer-issued; "seller" is for sellers issuing receipts in this format (see MODEL-RULE-v0.1.md, Article 2).

notes.description: Optional free-text notes. No secrets, no personal data beyond what is needed.

receipt_id.description: Receipt identifier, e.g. CPR-2026-7K2Q. The year is the year the receipt was created.

superseded_by.description: Reference to a seller-issued confirmation that supersedes this consumer receipt, if the seller later confirms in writing.

title: Cancel-Proof receipt
